claims.text: Sewer maintenance is a critical and largely unseen public service that keeps a municipality operating smoothly and hygienically.
claims.label: the unseen public service

claims.text: Sewer maintenance prevents blockages and repairs damage in the underground network of pipes that carries wastewater away from homes and businesses.
claims.label: the wastewater pipe network

claims.text: Maintenance begins with regular inspections that often lower CCTV cameras into the pipes to find cracks, root intrusion and other problems.
claims.label: CCTV pipe inspections

claims.text: Repair work ranges from simple patching of small cracks to extensive excavation and replacement of entire sections of pipe.
claims.label: the range of repairs

claims.text: Technicians use hot-patching, in which specialized materials are heated and applied to seal leaks.
claims.label: hot-patching leaks

claims.text: Crews clear obstructions with hydraulic jetters, powerful water jets that blast away grease and sludge, and with vacuum trucks that remove heavier material.
claims.label: jetters and vacuum trucks

claims.text: Regularly cleaning access points and manholes keeps rainwater and surface contaminants from infiltrating the sewer system.
claims.label: manhole and access-point cleaning
